description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target magic attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, MAG/MND/RES +30% to party, Cap Break Level 1, Switch Draw Mode II, Dual Awoken Instructor Mode I & Water/Poison Ability Damage +5% to user
Dual Awoken Instructor Mode I: Water/Poison Ability Boost, Triplecast Water/Poison & chases 2 Water/Poison abilities with 6 single-target Water/Poison/NE magic attacks (2.60 each) + RES -50% (max 2 chases)
Switch Draw Mode II: En-Water Stack or En-Poison Stack
